# Tuning

<!-- GENERATED by tools/tuning-doc.mjs from the live tuning registry. Do not edit by hand: run `npm run docs:tuning`. -->

Every gameplay number lives in the tuning registry (`src/core/tuning.ts`), registered by the system that owns it. Nothing reads a magic constant.

## How it works

```ts
import { defineTuning } from "../../core/tuning";
export const PLAYER = defineTuning("player", "Player", {
  jumpHeight: { default: 1.35, min: 0.5, max: 3, step: 0.05, label: "Jump apex height", unit: "m" },
});
PLAYER.jumpHeight; // live number, updated in place (zero-allocation reads in the hot loop)
```

- Paths are `<group>.<key>`, for example `player.jumpHeight`. Values are clamped to `[min, max]`.
- Change a value live, mid-run, without a restart: `window.__game.setTuning("player.jumpHeight", 1.6)`. Read all values with `window.__game.getTuning()` and the schema with `window.__game.tuningSchema()`.
- Setting a path before its group registers keeps the value pending and applies it on registration, so presets can load early.
- The in-game editor (piece D2) builds itself from this registry. Adding an entry needs zero editor code.
- After adding or changing entries run `npm run docs:tuning` to refresh this page.

## Game scenarios (7)

Deterministic layouts for `window.__game.startRun({ scenario })`, captures and tests (`src/game/spawn/scenarios.ts`).

| id | description |
|---|---|
| `default` | Normal seeded procedural run. |
| `flat-straight` | Empty straight track: no obstacles, no coins. Framing/speed reference. |
| `barrier-ahead` | One low barrier in the centre lane at 36 m; nothing else. |
| `train-ahead` | Two-car train in the centre lane from 60 m, coin line in the left lane alongside. |
| `train-side` | Three-car train in the left lane from 24 m (to ~65 m). Swipe left while alongside = stumble + bounce; twice quickly = caught. |
| `coin-line` | Ten coins in the centre lane from 16 m, 2 m apart. |
| `obstacle-kit` | Barrier centre at 40 m, train left from 70 m, barrier arc with coins right at 110 m. |
